steps.en: Install the suite and pick the solver family your problem fits
steps.zh: 装好套件，挑一个匹配你问题的求解器族

steps.en: Declare the variables, the constraints and the objective in that API
steps.zh: 在那个 API 里声明变量、约束和目标

steps.en: Compiles the Python model into the proto the C++ engine consumes
steps.zh: 把 Python 模型编译成 C++ 引擎消费的 proto

steps.en: Hand the model to the solver and ask it to solve
steps.zh: 把模型交给求解器，让它求解

steps.en: Searches with propagation, clause learning and large-neighbourhood search until optimal or the time limit
steps.zh: 用传播、子句学习与大邻域搜索一直搜，直到最优或到时间上限

steps.en: Returns the status and one value per variable, so you can read the plan back
steps.zh: 返回状态与每个变量的取值，让你把方案读回来

value.en: You get a provably optimal or best-found solution from one install that covers CP, LP, MIP, routing and assignment — without shopping for a solver per problem
value.zh: 一次安装就覆盖 CP、LP、MIP、路径与指派：你拿到可证明最优或当前最好的解，不用为每类问题各找一套求解器
